setting_b_requirement: At week t the method must condition on all arrived labels through t-1 and only 42 of 52 current outputs, then predict the 10 current hidden outputs with a predictive distribution.

evidence.finding: The official model imports vmamba.CrossMambaFusionBlock and vmamba.ConcatMambaFusionBlock, but no vmamba source file or declared vmamba dependency exists in the pinned 27-file repository snapshot.
The official batchifier constructs X with every node in the history window and an entire-node target vector Y at each forecast index; it accepts no current-week observation mask.
Official evaluation and training consume the full target Y and apply an L1 loss to the full output vector.
The forward interface consumes complete spline coefficients and a complete input window, returning deterministic outputs only.

decision: Do not write a Setting B adapter or fill in the missing vmamba implementation. Supporting 42 observed and 10 unobserved current outputs would require a masked-input/data interface, a masked training loss, and a predictive uncertainty mechanism absent from the official core.
reporting_rule: EARTH remains in the unified catalogue as a documented protocol-incompatible candidate and receives no formal Gaussian Setting B metric row.
